checks.native_scope: C ASan/UBSan with uninstrumented release Rust; leak sanitizer disabled.

attribute_oracle_disposition: All 6468 conditions match Expat acceptance, error codes, attribute/default callbacks and child outcomes; 1200 conditions corrected versus iterative baseline. Remaining 2580 position differences are pre-existing and counted separately.

alias_oracle.scope: CDATA and NMTOKENS, namespace modes, whole/1/2-byte feeds, direct/default/entity/default-PE/internal attributes, mixed physical and converted CR/LF, numeric references.

malformed_oracle.disposition: All baseline status/error results unchanged. The 12 changes are accepted parameter defaults with ignored missing references, correcting replacement CRLF to two spaces; complete candidate results match Expat.

independent_review.scope: Read-only semantic attribute composition against 37fdd00; no independent execution
independent_review.analysis: Physical line-ending normalization applies only when frames.is_empty(); parent Slice/rest restoration preserves original provenance, and nested replacements retain independent CR/LF. The fast copy guard excludes raw CR/LF/tab and aliases, so it cannot skip relevant normalization. Removing the default prepass preserves converted alias metadata and removes one allocation; raw whitespace remains invalid within malformed named/numeric references before and after, while complete DTD XML-character validation still precedes expansion. NDATA classification retains earlier recursion/depth/origin precedence and only separates unparsed from parsed external entities. Existing origin fallback semantics were reviewed separately.

limits: No changes to absolute limits, relative accounting operations, allocator ownership, or frame lifetimes. Removed the redundant default prepass so lexical provenance stays attached.
scope: No zero-failure API or production speed claim. Benchmarks and remaining API gaps are handled in other layers.
